objective: Preserve projection semantics while reordering interleaved Q/K/V rows into component-major order

baseline.hardware: CPU fixture; GPU availability not inspected

contract.precision_policy: CPU float64, small exactly representable fixture values
allowed_changes: Q/K/V row permutation and input layout validation

measurement.window: One bounded CPU verification run; no performance measurement

evidence: baseline.json records a same-shape projection mismatch
hypothesis.change: Map target[component * num_heads + head] to source[3 * head + component]

decision: keep correctness repair; CPU projection acceptance only
limitations: Validation covers synthetic CPU float64 projection fixtures only; no GPU or production-training validation was performed.
No complete model, gradients, optimizer update, task-quality, deployment runtime, or exact checkpoint-resume acceptance was tested.
Performance, throughput, training wall time, and memory were not measured.
